_meta.what: Published sales per location for chains with branches in Niagara Falls. National figures: a Niagara Falls branch can sit above the average (tourists), but rarely above the brand's best unit.

sources.pizza_pizza: Pizza Pizza Royalty Corp., Q4 and full-year 2025 results: Pizza Pizza royalty-pool sales $547.6M, 694 restaurants (https://retail-insider.com/retail-insider/2026/03/pizza-pizza-releases-q4-and-2025-annual-results/)
sources.keg: Keg Royalties Income Fund, Q2 2025: average sales per operating week $138,000 year to date, 104 restaurants (https://daytraders.com/news/2025/08/13/the-keg-royalties-income-fund-announces-second-quarter-2025-results)
sources.boston_pizza: Boston Pizza Royalties Income Fund: 2024 franchise sales $931.7M (https://newswire.ca/news-releases/boston-pizza-royalties-income-fund-announces-2024-fourth-quarter-and-annual-results-and-franchise-sales-of-931-7-million-for-the-year-858027642.html); about 372 restaurants (analyst note, https://www.suredividend.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BPZZF-2026-06-03.pdf). Count not from the Fund itself.
sources.tim_hortons: Tim Hortons franchise disclosure document, Item 19, as reviewed by Franchise Chatter (2023): median monthly gross sales $93,090, highest shop $330,167 a month (https://www.franchisechatter.com/2023/06/27/fdd-talk-tim-hortons-franchise-costs-fees-average-revenues-and-or-profits-2023-review/). Scope (US or Canada) not confirmed; second-hand.
sources.a_and_w: A&W Food Services of Canada, 2025 quarterly results: system sales Q1 $396.9M, Q2 $452.3M, Q3 $479.6M (https://awincomefund.mediaroom.com/2025-10-17-A-W-FOOD-SERVICES-OF-CANADA-INC-ANNOUNCES-THIRD-QUARTER-RESULTS-FOR-FISCAL-2025); Q4 assumed like Q1-Q3 average (~$443M) for ~$1.77B; about 1,060 restaurants (1,037 in early 2024 per a third-party profile, plus openings). Estimate.
sources.lcbo: LCBO fiscal 2022-23 retail store sales $5.87B (CBC, https://amp.cbc.ca/lite/story/1.7260107) over about 680 stores (LCBO filing). Older year; estimate.

_meta.not_found: McDonald's, Subway, A&W and Dollarama do not publish Canadian sales per location in what was found; Dollarama's $7.26B total includes Latin America and Australia. Canadian Tire sold its gas bars in 2025; Kalibrate's fuel census is paid.

Tim Hortons.quality: franchise disclosure, second-hand, median not mean

A&W.quality: estimate from system sales and approximate count

Dollarama.source: Dollarama Fiscal 2025 results (newswire.ca, 2025-04): sales $6,413.1M, stores 1,551 -> 1,616 (average 1,584), 53-week year; x52/53 = $3.97M per store.

Shoppers Drug Mart.source: Loblaw 2024 Annual Report: drug retail sales $17,620M, 1,361 Associate-owned drug stores; includes pharmacy dispensing.

Canadian Tire.source: Canadian Tire Corporation 2025 Annual Report: CTR sales per square foot $511 (rolling 12 months, excludes garden centres) x 24.4M sq ft / 502 Canadian Tire stores. Store only; gas bars excluded.
